# Changelog

All notable changes are listed here. The format follows [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/) and the
project follows [semantic versioning](https://semver.org/).

<!-- Unreleased changes live as fragment files in changelog.d/; do not edit this file directly. -->

## [0.1.2] - 2026-11-27

- Fixed: Enter on the "sysop: preparing the context" line now always starts the agent at once; bash could drop the key when it came as its 0.1 s poll timed out, and the agent then waited the full 30 s.
- Fixed: a goal the Sysop's panel sees as over (stopped, done or failed) now always has its final state in its live stream; the state file could say it ended a moment before the stream did.

## [0.1.1] - 2026-11-27

- Fixed: clicking or opening external `http(s)://` links from coding agents inside the box now routes through `swarmbox-open` (`$BROWSER` and `xdg-open`) to open in the Web Studio (with a 1-click fallback toast if blocked by a popup blocker) or copy via OSC 52 and show a clickable OSC 8 link in the Terminal Cockpit, instead of failing with "Couldn't open your browser".
- Fixed: `swarmbox update` / `sx update` pull progress bar now accounts for cached layers skipped by Podman (so progress reaches 99% and `unpack` instead of stopping in the 80s), uses consistent decimal MB units, and keeps the bar smoothly animated and aligned from the start.
- Added: in the Web Studio Sysop panel, live-streaming notes and replies now use a BBS Afterglow phosphor reveal effect (cooling from bright white through the active theme's light accent to normal text) paired with a glowing block cursor, respecting `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- Added: in the Web Studio repository worktrees popover, when Sysop is online, an "Ask Sysop to merge all" button sends a scoped end-to-end consolidation goal to Sysop to commit, resolve conflicts, merge, and clean all active and parked worktrees into the target branch.
- Fixed: a tab is no longer auto-named "Current title" or "Título atual". When the naming model explained its choice instead of answering with a title, the first words of that explanation became the tab's name; such an answer now keeps the current name.
- Changed: the shell prompt is now Mocha Rail, a two-line prompt in Catppuccin Mocha (the Web Studio's default theme): the context hangs from a `╭─` rail and you type after `╰─ ❯`. A failed command shows only its exit code in soft maroon, replacing the bold red `✕`, and the clock is gone.
- Changed: the Sysop names everything the same way: an agent or a shell only by the name you see (no tab id, no "the claude agent" beside it), a folder by its path, and a repo as "repo name"; `swarmbox state` now lists `folders` instead of `repos` (schema 2), so an agent in a folder without git is no longer called a repo.
- Changed: tab chips in the Sysop's conversation take the colour of their agent (claude, agy, codex, opencode), as their rows and cards in the tab bar do.
- Fixed: a tab renamed while the Sysop was talking about it (the automatic namer, or you) is still found and drawn as one chip by its older names.
- Changed: the sysop's brain is one resident Claude Code process instead of one per goal: a goal no longer pays a start (a short goal now answers in 1 to 3 seconds), and Stop interrupts the brain's turn instead of killing it, so the brain's record of what ran stays true and it keeps its session. A brain that dies or ignores the interrupt is started again on the same session.
- Added: the sysop keeps time and watches the box: ask it to check something every 10 minutes, at 18:00, or when a tab becomes blocked or prints a text, and it creates a schedule or a trigger that the host runs as a goal (pause, resume and cancel them in the Events tab of the Sysop panel, or with `swarmbox-sysop automation`). Every automation ends by itself, and one started by an automation cannot create another without your approval.
- Added: the sysop can ask you a question with buttons and wait for the answer, send you a notification (a toast in every open Web Studio and, once allowed in Settings → Sysop, the browser's own), keep notes across conversations, and read a log or a file of the box with its secrets removed instead of typing `cat` into a tab.
- Changed: a message you type or speak while the sysop works on a goal now reaches that goal at once ("no, the other tab") instead of waiting for it to end.
- Added: a click on the SWARMBOX title in the Web Studio (or on the version in Settings) opens an About popover with the SwarmBox version and the commit the image was built from, links to the release and the commit on GitHub, and a button that copies `SwarmBox vX.Y.Z (sha)` for bug reports.
- Fixed: the Web Studio loads again over slow or per-request links (such as the voice front's `Connection: close` through a tunnel): the image serves `/app.js` and `/viewer.js` as one bundle each, so `/` loads 11 scripts instead of 33 (20 requests instead of 42) and a single timed-out module no longer leaves an empty frame.
- Added: every Web Studio popover, the settings dialog, and the file preview drawer close from one `Esc ×` capsule at the right of the head: Esc closes them, and a click on the capsule does too (on a phone it shows a larger `×`). The separate close X of the settings dialog and the drawer is gone.
- Fixed: the Markdown viewer no longer turns wide with empty space on the right when a document has a long URL or inline code; the text wraps inside the page.
- Fixed: an open worktree or repository popover now refreshes its Git status every few seconds, so a commit or edit made in a shell shows without reopening it.

## [0.1.0] - 2026-11-26

First public pre-1.0 release of SwarmBox.

- Added: persistent rootless Podman box (`swarmbox` / `sx` host command and `install.sh` installer) with nested rootless Podman, workspace mounting, key-based configuration (`swarmbox config`), secret injection (`swarmbox env`), image updates (`swarmbox update`), and signed multi-arch (`amd64` + `arm64`) container images at `ghcr.io/feroult/swarmbox`.
- Added: Herdr Web Studio and SSH Terminal Cockpit backed by `herdr-core`, with desktop and mobile layouts, overlay scrollbars, touch scrolling, zero-dependency syntax-highlighted file viewer, multi-client PTY viewport ownership, and optional remote access via Cloudflare Tunnel (`cloudflare-setup.py`).
- Added: declarative Agent Registry (`swarmbox-agents`) and on-demand addon system (`swarmbox addon`), shipping coding-agent addons for Claude Code (`claude`), Antigravity (`antigravity`), OpenCode (`opencode`), and OpenAI Codex (`codex`) alongside tool addons, shared box MCP servers (including headless Chromium `chrome-devtools`), and per-agent auto-approve wrappers.
- Added: persistent pinned agent sessions (`swarmbox pins`) with `Auto-start` and zero-RAM `PARKED` boot modes, and Git Worktrees (`swarmbox-worktree`) for multi-agent repository isolation with collision detection, `.env*` copying, in-memory dry-run merge checks, and 1-click merge/cleanup flows.
- Added: autonomous `sysop` operator addon with a hermetic Landlock-sandboxed brain, live streaming events and controls (Stop, Queue, autonomy levels including `full-auto`), repository context digests (`sysop.autocontext`), and automatic prompt-based tab naming (`sysop.autoname`).
- Added: local `whisper.cpp` voice input addon (`voice`) with tap-to-record Voice Bar in the Web Studio.
